Rina Patel: Hi everyone! I'm Rina, joining Developer Experience as a Documentation Engineer. First week today, remote. Very excited to meet folks . Quick question: where do people stash the canonical code snippets for API quickstarts?

Devon H: Welcome Rina!! The "developer-samples" repo in GitHub is the source-of-truth for snippets. If you need edit access, ping me and I'll send an invite. Also :coffee: meetup at 4pm today in the breakroom for folks near HQ.

Leah M: Hi Rina, welcome! Also FYI the docs team uses a tiny script to extract snippets from markdown files. I can share it in a DM.

hr-bot: Rina, your benefits orientation is scheduled for Friday at 11am. Please confirm attendance.

Rina Patel: Thanks! Yes I can do Friday 11. For the 4pm coffee, I'll pop by if my timezone aligns (I'm EST).

Marco S: Welcome Rina! Pro tip: on your first day, the snack drawer is stocked with those spicy chips that are dangerously addictive.

Carmen T: Also adding you to #docs-reviewers. We have a small rotation for quick PR reviews so you might be on-call for that next sprint.

Rina Patel: Awesome  thrilled to be here and looking forward to the snack drawer.
